import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
from datetime import datetime

# Create the dataset
data = {
    'ID': [5524, 2174, 4141, 6182, 5324],
    'Year_Birth': [1957, 1954, 1965, 1984, 1981],
    'Education': ['Graduation', 'Graduation', 'Graduation', 'Graduation', 'PhD'],
    'Marital_Status': ['Single', 'Single', 'Together', 'Together', 'Married'],
    'Income': [58138.0, 46344.0, 71613.0, 26646.0, 58293.0],
    'Kidhome': [0, 1, 0, 1, 1],
    'Teenhome': [0, 1, 0, 0, 0],
    'Dt_Customer': ['04-09-2012', '08-03-2014', '21-08-2013', '10-02-2014', '19-01-2014'],
    'Recency': [58, 38, 26, 26, 94],
    'MntWines': [635, 11, 426, 11, 173],
    'MntFruits': [88, 1, 49, 4, 43],
    'MntMeatProducts': [546, 6, 127, 20, 118],
    'MntFishProducts': [172, 2, 111, 10, 46],
    'MntSweetProducts': [88, 1, 21, 3, 27],
    'MntGoldProds': [88, 6, 42, 5, 15],
    'NumDealsPurchases': [3, 2, 1, 2, 5],
    'NumWebPurchases': [8, 1, 8, 2, 5],
    'NumCatalogPurchases': [10, 1, 2, 0, 3],
    'NumStorePurchases': [4, 2, 10, 4, 6],
    'NumWebVisitsMonth': [7, 5, 4, 6, 5],
    'AcceptedCmp3': [0, 0, 0, 0, 0],
    'AcceptedCmp4': [0, 0, 0, 0, 0],
    'AcceptedCmp5': [0, 0, 0, 0, 0],
    'AcceptedCmp1': [0, 0, 0, 0, 0],
    'AcceptedCmp2': [0, 0, 0, 0, 0],
    'Complain': [0, 0, 0, 0, 0],
    'Z_CostContact': [3, 3, 3, 3, 3],
    'Z_Revenue': [11, 11, 11, 11, 11],
    'Response': [1, 0, 0, 0, 0]
}

df = pd.DataFrame(data)

# Convert date column
df['Dt_Customer'] = pd.to_datetime(df['Dt_Customer'], format='%d-%m-%Y')
df['Age'] = datetime.now().year - df['Year_Birth']

# Set style
sns.set_style("whitegrid")
plt.figure(figsize=(16, 12))

# Create subplots
fig, axes = plt.subplots(3, 3, figsize=(18, 15))

# 1. Income distribution by Education
sns.boxplot(data=df, x='Education', y='Income', ax=axes[0,0], palette='Set2')
axes[0,0].set_title('Income Distribution by Education Level')
axes[0,0].set_xlabel('Education')
axes[0,0].set_ylabel('Income')

# 2. Age distribution
axes[0,1].hist(df['Age'], bins=15, color='skyblue', edgecolor='black', alpha=0.7)
axes[0,1].set_title('Age Distribution')
axes[0,1].set_xlabel('Age')
axes[0,1].set_ylabel('Frequency')

# 3. Marital Status distribution
marital_counts = df['Marital_Status'].value_counts()
axes[0,2].pie(marital_counts.values, labels=marital_counts.index, autopct='%1.1f%%', 
              colors=sns.color_palette('pastel'), startangle=90)
axes[0,2].set_title('Marital Status Distribution')

# 4. Product spending comparison
product_cols = ['MntWines', 'MntFruits', 'MntMeatProducts', 'MntFishProducts', 
                'MntSweetProducts', 'MntGoldProds']
product_means = df[product_cols].mean()
axes[1,0].bar(range(len(product_means)), product_means.values, 
              color=sns.color_palette('husl', len(product_means)))
axes[1,0].set_title('Average Spending by Product Category')
axes[1,0].set_xlabel('Product Category')
axes[1,0].set_ylabel('Average Amount Spent')
axes[1,0].set_xticks(range(len(product_means)))
axes[1,0].set_xticklabels([col.replace('Mnt', '') for col in product_cols], rotation=45)

# 5. Purchase channels comparison
purchase_cols = ['NumWebPurchases', 'NumCatalogPurchases', 'NumStorePurchases']
purchase_data = df[purchase_cols].sum()
axes[1,1].bar(purchase_data.index, purchase_data.values, color=['#FF6B6B', '#4ECDC4', '#45B7D1'])
axes[1,1].set_title('Total Purchases by Channel')
axes[1,1].set_ylabel('Total Purchases')
axes[1,1].tick_params(axis='x', rotation=45)

# 6. Income vs Wine Spending
sns.scatterplot(data=df, x='Income', y='MntWines', hue='Education', 
                size='Age', sizes=(50, 200), ax=axes[1,2], alpha=0.7)
axes[1,2].set_title('Income vs Wine Spending')
axes[1,2].set_xlabel('Income')
axes[1,2].set_ylabel('Wine Spending')

# 7. Household composition
df['Total_Children'] = df['Kidhome'] + df['Teenhome']
child_counts = df['Total_Children'].value_counts().sort_index()
axes[2,0].bar(child_counts.index, child_counts.values, color='lightcoral')
axes[2,0].set_title('Household Children Distribution')
axes[2,0].set_xlabel('Number of Children')
axes[2,0].set_ylabel('Count')
axes[2,0].set_xticks(child_counts.index)

# 8. Recency distribution
sns.histplot(data=df, x='Recency', bins=10, kde=True, ax=axes[2,1], color='mediumseagreen')
axes[2,1].set_title('Recency Distribution (Days Since Last Purchase)')
axes[2,1].set_xlabel('Recency (days)')
axes[2,1].set_ylabel('Frequency')

# 9. Web visits vs purchases
sns.scatterplot(data=df, x='NumWebVisitsMonth', y='NumWebPurchases', 
                hue='Marital_Status', size='Income', ax=axes[2,2], alpha=0.7)
axes[2,2].set_title('Web Visits vs Web Purchases')
axes[2,2].set_xlabel('Monthly Web Visits')
axes[2,2].set_ylabel('Web Purchases')

plt.suptitle('Customer Data Analysis Dashboard', fontsize=16, fontweight='bold', y=1.02)
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output.png', dpi=300, bbox_inches='tight')
plt.close()
